label: Housing
assignment: Discover realistic ways a person without adequate housing in {service_area} could obtain safe temporary or permanent housing. Follow useful relationships rather than stopping at a directory listing: voucher providers to participating motels, organizations to specific programs, and temporary options to longer-term pathways. Investigate practical access and lived experience as well as official claims.
include: Emergency shelter and safe temporary lodging
Motel or hotel vouchers and the particular lodging providers that accept them
Transitional, supportive, sober, reentry, treatment-linked, and medically appropriate housing
Rent, deposit, utility, rapid-rehousing, subsidized, and permanent-housing pathways
Pet-friendly options and temporary animal care when pet rules block access
exclude: Ordinary market-rate real-estate listings without an affordability or access pathway
Housing directories that do not identify a currently reachable program or provider
Programs whose geography, population, or referral requirements exclude people in the service area

sourceChannels: official city, county, housing-authority, and continuum-of-care pages
operating nonprofit and faith-community program pages
official referral, eligibility, and coordinated-entry documents
current funding awards and provider contracts that identify operating programs

focuses.label: Crisis shelter and immediate lodging
focuses.direction: Find specific year-round, seasonal, family, youth, domestic-violence-safe, and medically appropriate places a person can enter now or through a defined referral.

focuses.label: Vouchers, diversion, and rapid rehousing
focuses.direction: Trace administering organizations to the named assistance program and practical application or referral path; do not stop at a general funding description.

focuses.label: Supportive and population-specific housing
focuses.direction: Find directly operated transitional or permanent housing tied to disability, behavioral health, reentry, recovery, youth, veterans, families, or medical vulnerability.

focuses.label: Affordable and subsidized housing pathways
focuses.direction: Find currently actionable subsidized properties, voucher pathways, and nonprofit affordable-housing programs with a real waitlist, application, or eligibility route.

focuses.label: Non-obvious community housing programs
focuses.direction: Look inside broader community, refugee, disability, family, faith, and anti-poverty organizations for named housing programs that ordinary housing searches miss.
